title: Work with lists
description: You use list operations to select, combine, and generate elements. Lazy evaluation computes elements as they are needed.

steps.description: head selects the first element. tail selects the rest. The ++ operator joins two lists.
You can count, reverse, take, drop, or pair elements with the operations shown here.
Range notation generates a sequence. A second starting value sets its step.
take requests a finite prefix from an infinite list. repeat supplies one value repeatedly, while cycle repeats a list.
